report:
signal.data.collection separate schema

Hi,

My DEBEZIUM_SIGNAL table is in a separate schema.

io.debezium.DebeziumException: Unable to find relational table model for 'FREE.BASEADM_1.DEBEZIUM_SIGNAL', there may be an issue with your include/exclude list configuration.
I have to add FREE.BASEADM_1.DEBEZIUM_SIGNAL  to snapshot.include.collection.list to make it work.

evidence.quote: I would say that's a bug Greg, as you should be able to use schema.history.internal.store.only.captured.tables.ddl=true with a signal table in a separate schema.

notes: Error text blames include/exclude config, but readTableStructure only reads schemas of capturedTables while the signal table (other schema) is in capturedSchemaTables, so its model is missing. Reporter traced it in RelationalSnapshotChangeEventSource.

reviews.fix: Code fix (DBZ-9717) so the signal table in a separate schema is loaded when store.only.captured.tables.ddl=true with snapshot.include.collection.list.
